blocks.html: Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C in accordance with Section 1613, reinforcement shall be provided in accordance with Section 1812.1.2.4. Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category D, reinforcement shall be provided in accordance with Section 1812.1.2.5.
